zh.title: 定制开口套筒
zh.requirement: 紧固件周边存在管路或结构遮挡，标准闭口套筒无法直接套入。
zh.customization: 通过开口轮廓与专用长度设计，为侧向进入和受限空间保留操作路径。
zh.application: 管路连接、传感器安装与特殊装配工位。

en.title: Custom Open Socket
en.requirement: Pipes or surrounding structures prevent a standard closed socket from entering the fastener directly.
en.customization: An open profile and purpose-built length preserve a side-entry path in confined spaces.
en.application: Pipe connections, sensor installation, and special assembly stations.

zh.title: 快速导入套筒
zh.requirement: 自动化工位需要更稳定地引导套筒进入紧固件位置。
zh.customization: 在入口结构、导向轮廓和接口匹配上进行针对性设计。
zh.application: 机器人拧紧、节拍化装配与重复定位。

en.title: Fast-entry Socket
en.requirement: An automated station needs more stable guidance as the socket approaches the fastener.
en.customization: The entry geometry, guiding profile, and drive interface are designed for the application.
en.application: Robotic tightening, cycle-based assembly, and repeated positioning.

zh.title: 固定磁内六角套筒
zh.requirement: 装配过程中需要辅助保持紧固件，降低掉落和偏移风险。
zh.customization: 将固定磁保持方式与内六角工作端组合，并按接口和空间确认结构。
zh.application: 垂直、倒置或狭窄空间装配。

en.title: Fixed-magnet Hex Socket
en.requirement: The fastener needs additional retention during assembly to reduce dropping and misalignment.
en.customization: A fixed-magnet retention method is combined with the hex working end and matched to the interface and available space.

zh.title: 起子转换头
zh.requirement: 装配工具需要在起子批头与设备接口之间完成稳定转换。
zh.customization: 按输入端、输出端、连接长度与保持方式匹配转换结构。
zh.application: 自动化工位、设备维护与多接口装配任务。

en.title: Screwdriver Bit Adapter
en.requirement: The assembly tool needs a stable transition between the driver bit and the equipment interface.
en.customization: The conversion structure is matched to the input, output, connection length, and retention method.
en.application: Automated stations, equipment maintenance, and multi-interface assembly.

zh.title: 火花塞套筒
zh.requirement: 深孔位置需要匹配长度、外径与紧固件轮廓的专用套筒。
zh.customization: 结合工作端深度、外部空间与内部保持要求确认结构。
zh.application: 发动机、发电设备及相关维护工位。

en.title: Spark Plug Socket
en.requirement: A deep recess requires a dedicated socket matched to the working length, outside diameter, and fastener profile.
en.customization: The structure is defined around working-end depth, available space, and internal retention requirements.
en.application: Engines, generator equipment, and related maintenance stations.
